body: {"rules":[{"id":"force_push","label":"Force push","help":"git push --force, -f, --force-with-lease or a +ref","on":true,"default":true},{"id":"delete","label":"Delete files or branches","help":"rm, git rm, git clean, git branch -d/-D, find -delete, rmdir, unlink when they reach outside the project; git push --delete","on":true,"default":true},{"id":"git_push","label":"Git push","help":"every git push","on":false,"default":false},{"id":"git_tag","label":"Git tag","help":"creating, moving or deleting a tag (listing is fine)","on":false,"default":false},{"id":"publish","label":"Publish a package","help":"npm/pnpm/yarn/bun publish, cargo publish, twine upload, gem push, poetry/uv/flit publish, docker push, gh release create","on":false,"default":false}]}
